title: How to use icon sets
slide_intent: Teach designers when pictorial cues can make text easier to scan and how a change of background affects the legibility of those cues.
strategic_value: Voltera can repeat recognizable line drawings while varying the accent color and backing to suit a display context.
demonstration: The upper grid repeats the same icon set with blue or green accents. The lower grid repeats it on colored tiles for contexts that switch between light and dark modes.
practical_value: Select an unbacked icon when the background is controlled and a colored tile when the surface can switch modes.
